usageEntries.familySummary: Spacious chaise sofa with easy-care polyester upholstery and metal legs. Available with left or right chaise in Beige, brown, or grey.

The Haven dining table features a sleek design with a durable aluminium frame and warm polyrattan finish. Its elegant glass top is easy to maintain. Measuring 200 x 100 cm, it provides ample space and assembles in about 30 minutes.

Messina dining table 220x100 cm provides a practical and elegant outdoor dining option. Its natural toned top and aluminium frame create a modern Scandinavian look. Suitable for garden, terrace or large balcony, it offers a spacious and low-maintenance surface.
